name: Teapot with Landscape and Imperial Poem (lid)
aliases: 山水御製詩貼金宜興壺
material: Stoneware, with gold pigment, Yixing ware
summary: This teapot with a polished surface shows an imperial poem in gold on one side and a landscape on the other.
